title: All {count} Emotes in Anime Vanguards
meta_description: Compare Anime Vanguards emotes by availability and unlock route, including achievements, Trophy Exchange, shops, evolution, and bundles.
intro_md: Emotes turn progression rewards and shop currency into player expressions you can keep. Their value is personal, but their unlock routes are not, so it helps to know whether the next dance asks for a difficult clear, a Trophy purchase, a unit evolution, or a bundle.
description_md:
## Unlocking emotes through achievements

Achievement emotes are tied to named completion goals such as Story, Raid, Dungeon, or Collector groups. Finish the exact achievement named in Obtainment, including its required acts or related objectives, before expecting the emote reward. A nearly completed group remains impressively close and equally unemotional.

These routes pair well with normal progression because the same clears can advance maps, reward tracks, and other achievement bonuses. Work on the group you already need rather than choosing an emote that sends your account into unrelated content.

## Spending at Trophy Exchange and shops

Trophy Exchange offers a direct purchase route for several emotes. Its active prices belong to the in-game exchange, so decide which expression you want before spending Trophies across several smaller temptations.

Other shop emotes use their named mode currency. Boss Event Shop can require Commander Tokens or Corrupted Tokens, while a Legacy Shop route can use Legacy Coins. Those currencies are not interchangeable, so match the emote to the activity that fills the correct wallet.

## Evolution and bundle unlocks

God Requiem Emote is linked to evolving Haruka Rin. This makes the emote part of a unit progression goal, not a separate shop purchase, so the evolution path should already be useful to your roster before it becomes an emote project.

Piano Emote comes from its named bundle. Bundle access and pricing can change, so the current in-game offer decides whether that route is open. The piano may be dramatic, but it still respects store availability.

## Reading availability

Available means the listed unlock route is treated as open, while the exact shop, exchange, event, or bundle conditions can still change. Use Obtainment to identify the route, then confirm its live requirements before spending currency or planning a limited activity.

An old event or shop association does not guarantee that a retired route will return. If availability changes, a past requirement explains how the emote was earned without creating a new way to claim it.
how_it_works_md: Status shows whether the unlock route is available. Obtainment gives the exact achievement, exchange, shop currency, unit evolution, or bundle tied to the emote.

faq_json.q: How do Achievement emotes unlock in Anime Vanguards?
faq_json.a: Complete the exact named achievement in the emote's Obtainment requirement. Story, Raid, Dungeon, and Collector groups can each lead to different emote rewards.

faq_json.q: Where do I buy Trophy Exchange emotes?
faq_json.a: They are purchased through Trophy Exchange. The active exchange shows the current Trophy price for each available emote.

faq_json.q: Do Boss Event Shop emotes use the same currency?
faq_json.a: Not always. An emote can require Commander Tokens, Corrupted Tokens, or a separate Legacy Coins route, so follow its named shop and currency.

faq_json.q: Which evolution unlocks God Requiem Emote?
faq_json.a: Evolving Haruka Rin unlocks God Requiem Emote. It is tied to that unit progression step rather than Trophy Exchange.
Piano Emote comes from the Piano Emote bundle. Its current availability and price depend on the live in-game offer.

faq_json.q: Does Available guarantee an event shop is always open?
faq_json.a: No. It marks the listed route as available, but live event, shop, exchange, and bundle conditions can change. Confirm the active in-game requirement before spending.

Shop routes use their named currencies, while God Requiem comes from evolving Haruka Rin and Piano Emote comes from its bundle. Availability and Obtainment show whether the route is open and what progress or currency it needs.
